method.candidate: 320 ms Hann projections every 40 ms on a 1 kHz analysis copy. Require tones at centers 240 ms before and after both boundaries. Interpolate phase across the outer supports and measure the interior residual. Compare the best single tone and two compatible harmonics.
method.control: Continuous tone, local gain, low-pass, publisher voice splice under continuous tone, whole delay, no added tone, smooth tone warp, and isolated ambient recordings.
method.point: Strictly exceed the greater of .60 or the largest ordinary development-group score. A broader point uses the second-highest group maximum.
method.source: New source-disjoint SINE reader groups. Two previously unused tone sources per role. Rain, train or concurrent speech at +5 dB relative to original speech RMS.
method.tone: Mix recorded hum at -7 or -13 dB relative to the foreground. Test a temporary splice in the tone and separately in the entire mix. Preserve samples outside the labeled span.
method.utility: A useful range covers at least half the labeled edit and reaches .30 temporal intersection over union. Also count both endpoints within 120 ms.
